summary: no-project assertions (lines ~276-279) check a freshly-constructed, never-refreshed DiffModel's default property values (summary=nil, isLoading=false, hasLoadedOnce=false) — a tautology true for any un-refreshed instance, not the real no-project code path in RightPaneView.swift (reviewProject==nil -> ComingSoonPane), which is never exercised by any test; a violation that merged no-project into the initial-loading/populated summary view would not be caught.
